item.tib: gsang ba'i grub chen brgyad bcu'i phyag mchod kyi rim pa rgyu skar rgyan gyi phreng ba
item.coloph: de ltar g.yung drung bon gyi gsang ba'i grub chen brgya bcu (brgyad bcu'i) mdzad pa'i phrin las grub pa thob pa'i tshul dang zab lam gyi rtsal shugs nges par ston pa mdo tsam bsdus nas phyag mchod rim pa rgyu skar rgyan gyi phreng ba zhes bya ba rang gzhung rgyud lung phal mo che dang gsang mchog gi bshad byang ltar dmu rgyal rnal 'byor nyi ma'i ming can gyis rta sgo rge rgan gyi lha zhal dang ra mtsho sman dang mthong ba'i sug rtse zhes bya ba'i gnas su brtsams pa dge'o//
